mapper.select: SELECT file_node_id AS fileNodeId, COUNT(*) AS totalChunkCount, SUM(audit_status = 'pending') AS pendingChunkCount, SUM(audit_status = 'approved') AS approvedChunkCount, SUM(audit_status = 'rejected') AS rejectedChunkCount FROM kb_chunk WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY file_node_id
